description: This file defines various parameter classes and enums used in FastAPI for handling request parameters such as query, path, header, cookie, and request body. It includes classes for parameter metadata, dependency injection, and security scopes.

classes.name: ParamTypes
classes.description: Enumeration of parameter locations in HTTP requests (query, header, path, cookie).

classes.name: Param
classes.description: Class representing a request parameter with metadata such as alias, validation, and serialization options.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Subclass of Param for path parameters, which cannot have default values.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: Subclass of Param for query parameters.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Subclass of Param for header parameters, with underscore conversion option.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: Subclass of Param for cookie parameters.

classes.name: Body
classes.description: Class representing request body parameters, with media type and embedding options.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: Subclass of Body for form data with URL-encoded media type.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Subclass of Form for file uploads with multipart/form-data media type.

classes.name: Depends
classes.description: Class for dependency injection, holding a dependency callable, cache usage, and scope.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Subclass of Depends for security scopes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructors for parameter classes, initializing metadata and validation options.

search-terms: Path, Query, Header, Cookie, Body classes
